svg.text: Every call produces a record (from number, to number, start, duration) in the call records DB

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Customer management populates the customer DB; billing only reads both (arrows show information flow)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Periodic job scans the customer DB for billing cycles that ended; staggered cycles smooth the load

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Workers take jobs from the queue; the orchestrator scales workers up or down with queue depth

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each worker reads the customer's ~300 calls for the period (shard found from phone number) plus the plan, then writes one bill document per customer per cycle; history kept indefinitely

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Portal reads bill documents; payment itself is out of scope

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bill-generation service renders each bill as PDF / email / physical mail

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Customer receives and pays; paid-state can be written back to the customer DB

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Scale: 50M subscribers × 10 billable calls/day = 500M calls/day ≈ 15B/month; 50M bills/month; bills ready within 24 h of cycle end

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Sharding: by phone number (area code / exchange, merged for sparse areas), or hash the whole number where no geography exists (e.g. UK)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Availability: ≥2 copies per shard, redundant orchestrators/workers, no single point of failure; security: internal-only network, encryption at rest, hardened portal
